spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator module¶

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator(actuator_owner)[source]¶

Bases: object

Base class for actuators. Any actuator to be implemented in the simulator must inherit (directly or indirectly) from this base class.

Parameters:actuator_owner (Robot) – instance of the agent executing the actuator.
step(action)[source]¶

Method to execute an iteration of the actuator. In this base class it is empty and must be overwritten by actuators inheriting from it in order to particularize their functionality. Essentially, this method transforms actions planned by the robot controller into real interactions with the environment.

Parameters:action (np.ndarray) – vector or scalar action to be executed.
physics_client¶

Returns the physics engine client of the robot owning the actuator.

owner_id¶

Returns the identifier of the robot owning the actuator.

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.HighLevelActuator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator

Base class for high level actuators. A high level actuator is an actuator that either makes use of global information that would not be available in reality or that simplifies the implementation of an more complex actuator for easing simulation. For the moment this class is completely void and it is merely used to keep track of which actuators are high level and which are not.

Parameters:actuator_owner (Robot) – instance of the agent executing the actuator.
step(action, neighborhood)[source]¶

Method to execute an iteration of the actuator. In this base class it is empty and must be overwritten by high level actuators inheriting from it in order to particularize their functionality. Essentially, this method transforms actions planned by the robot controller into real interactions with the environment.

Parameters:action (np.ndarray) – vector or scalar action to be executed.

spike_swarm_sim.actuators.joint_actuator module¶

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.joint_actuator.JointVelocityActuator(*args, joint_ids=[0], inverse_mirrored=None, max_velocity=10.0, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator

The joint velocity actuator controls the velocity of the joints of a robot. Given a reference velocity (action), the actuator drives the velocity of the joint towards the desired target value.

Parameters:
  • joint ids (list) – list of the joint ids to be controlled.
  • max_velocity (float) – maximum velocity of the joint (CHECK).
  • inverse_mirrored (bool) – Whether to control two joints with the same velocity reference but with opposite sign. For example, this feature is useful when controlling two-wheeled mobile robots that only rotate. In this case, the robot controller would only plan an scalar action with the velocity and sign.
step(action)[source]¶

Steps the actuator by transforming the action planed by the robot controller into an actual joint rotation speed. The action argument is a vector settling the desired reference velocity of each joint to be controlled. The action references are contrained within [-1, 1], meaning that an action of 1 means maximum velocity in one sense and -1 represents maximum velocity in the opposite sense. An action of 0 means no rotation at all.

Parameters:action (np.ndarray) – numpy array collection the normalized reference velocities of each joint to be controlled.
reset()[source]¶

Resets the actuator.

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.joint_actuator.JointPositionActuator(*args, joint_ids=[0], **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator

The joint position actuator controls the position of the joints of a robot. Given a reference angle position (action), the actuator drives the position of the joint towards the desired target value.

Parameters:
  • joint ids (list) – list of the joint ids to be controlled.
  • max_velocity (float) – maximum velocity of the joint (CHECK).
  • inverse_mirrored (bool) – Whether to control two joints with the same velocity reference but with opposite sign. For example, this feature is useful when controlling two-wheeled mobile robots that only rotate. In this case, the robot controller would only plan an scalar action with the velocity and sign.
step(action)[source]¶

Steps the actuator by transforming the action planed by the robot controller into an actual joint angle position. The action argument is a vector settling the desired reference positions of each joint to be controlled. The action references are contrained within [-1, 1], which are mapped into [-pi, pi] inside the method.

Parameters:action (np.ndarray) – numpy array collection the normalized reference velocities of each joint to be controlled.

spike_swarm_sim.actuators.communication_transmitter module¶

class spike_swarm_sim.actuators.communication_transmitter.CommunicationTransmitter(*args, range=2, msg_length=1, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: spike_swarm_sim.actuators.base_actuator.Actuator

Communication transmitter actuator. It isotropically transmits a frame with a message and its context. The propagation simulation is implemented at the receiver side, this class only updates the transmitted frame of each robot.

  • Params:

    range [float] : maximum distance of message reception, in centimeters. msg_length [int] : number of components of the message. quantize [bool] : whether to quantize the message to a set of possible

    symbols or not.
